# GAEKS Freight (PT Global Andalan Ekspress)

> Tagline Resmi: "Diperkuat oleh Manusia. Digerakkan oleh Teknologi. Berfokus pada Anda." ("Powered by People. Driven by Technology. Focused on You.")

GAEKS Freight (PT Global Andalan Ekspress) adalah perusahaan freight forwarding internasional dan jasa kepabeanan (PPJK) di Indonesia dengan fokus keunggulan pada FCL Export/Import dan Air Freight Export/Import, didukung LCL, Customs Clearance/PPJK (PIB/PEB), Undername Impor & Persetujuan Impor (PI, termasuk PI besi dan baja), penyediaan/sewa kapal RORO dan Breakbulk, Project Cargo & Heavy Lift, Domestic Trucking, serta Pergudangan & Bongkar Muat di Jakarta (Tanjung Priok), Semarang, dan Surabaya. Jadwal, kapasitas ruang, tarif, dan persyaratan izin dikonfirmasi untuk setiap pengiriman.

## Panduan Layanan (Bahasa Indonesia)

- [FCL (Full Container Load)](https://gaeks.com/layanan/freight-laut-fcl/): Konsultasikan kebutuhan pengiriman kontainer penuh (FCL) ekspor dan impor 20ft, 40ft, High Cube, atau Reefer secara port-to-port maupun door-to-door.
- [Air Shipment Priority](https://gaeks.com/layanan/freight-udara/): Konsultasikan pengiriman kargo udara ekspor maupun impor dengan prioritas biaya yang efisien, jadwal penerbangan sesuai tenggat, dan kualitas penanganan yang terjaga.
- [LCL (Less than Container Load)](https://gaeks.com/layanan/freight-laut-lcl/): Konsultasikan pengiriman laut konsolidasi (LCL) untuk muatan di bawah satu kontainer penuh dengan perhitungan CBM yang jelas.
- [PPJK (Customs Clearance)](https://gaeks.com/layanan/ppjk-customs-clearance/): Konsultasikan customs clearance ekspor atau impor, dokumen PIB/PEB, SKI, dan peninjauan HS code untuk pelabuhan maupun bandara di Jakarta, Semarang, dan Surabaya.
- [Undername Impor & Persetujuan Impor (PI)](https://gaeks.com/layanan/undername-impor-pi/): Konsultasikan skema undername impor dan persyaratan Persetujuan Impor (PI), termasuk komoditas besi dan baja, untuk gerbang pelabuhan Jakarta, Semarang, dan Surabaya.
- [Penyediaan / Sewa Kapal RORO & Breakbulk](https://gaeks.com/layanan/roro-breakbulk/): Konsultasikan penyediaan ruang dan sewa kapal RORO maupun breakbulk untuk kendaraan, alat berat tambang/konstruksi, mesin industri, dan muatan non-kontainer.
- [Project Cargo & Heavy Lift](https://gaeks.com/layanan/project-cargo-heavy-lift/): Diskusikan perencanaan kargo proyek, alat berat, dan muatan Out of Gauge (OOG) termasuk survei rute, titik angkat, serta koordinasi multimoda hingga lokasi proyek.
- [Domestic Trucking](https://gaeks.com/layanan/trucking/): Konsultasikan trucking kontainer pelabuhan, sambungan kargo bandara, maupun distribusi darat antarkota langsung menuju gudang dan pabrik Anda.
- [Gudang & PBM (Bongkar Muat)](https://gaeks.com/layanan/pergudangan-stevedoring/): Konsultasikan kebutuhan penyimpanan gudang transit, konsolidasi muatan, dan bongkar muat dermaga untuk kargo ekspor, impor, maupun domestik.

## Services Overview (English)

- [FCL (Full Container Load)](https://gaeks.com/en/layanan/freight-laut-fcl/): Consult international FCL ocean freight export and import across 20ft, 40ft, High Cube, and Reefer equipment with integrated port clearance and inland delivery.
- [Air Shipment Priority](https://gaeks.com/en/layanan/freight-udara/): Consult export and import air freight shipments balancing cost-conscious airline options, dependable transit schedules, and careful terminal handling.
- [LCL (Less than Container Load)](https://gaeks.com/en/layanan/freight-laut-lcl/): Consult LCL ocean consolidation for export and import shipments under a full container load.
- [PPJK (Customs Clearance)](https://gaeks.com/en/layanan/ppjk-customs-clearance/): Consult import and export customs clearance, PIB/PEB declarations, HS code reviews, and regulatory compliance across major Indonesian ports and airports.
- [Undername Impor & Persetujuan Impor (PI)](https://gaeks.com/en/layanan/undername-impor-pi/): Consult compliant undername import representation and Import Approval (PI) screening, including steel commodities, via Jakarta, Semarang, and Surabaya.
- [Penyediaan / Sewa Kapal RORO & Breakbulk](https://gaeks.com/en/layanan/roro-breakbulk/): Consult RORO and breakbulk vessel sourcing or charter options for wheeled equipment, heavy machinery, and non-containerized industrial cargo.
- [Project Cargo & Heavy Lift](https://gaeks.com/en/layanan/project-cargo-heavy-lift/): Consult project cargo feasibility, route surveys, heavy lift engineering, and multimodal delivery for oversized industrial shipments.
- [Domestic Trucking](https://gaeks.com/en/layanan/trucking/): Consult container trucking from ports, air cargo pickup, and intercity road distribution to your warehouse or factory.
- [Gudang & PBM (Bongkar Muat)](https://gaeks.com/en/layanan/pergudangan-stevedoring/): Consult transit warehouse storage, cargo consolidation, and stevedoring operations for import, export, and domestic cargo.
